rows.en: Having given up on Shocker and Gel-Shocker, the mysterious figure known only as the Great Leader formed a new secret society, Destron…
To counter the heroes' growing strength, he gathered in Japan the top executives of Destron's branches, which had been carrying out sabotage and occupation operations all over the world.

Welcome… the mightiest men our Destron has to boast of!

Doktor G, Archbishop Wing, Baron Fang, and Marshal Armor!

My dear Great Leader…

Now that I am here, I shall surely dispose of those accursed Kamen Raaiders…
Hmph, what's that? Our enemy is Kamen Rider, not "Kamen Raaider".
Come now, does it matter either way? That name… will soon vanish anyway.
Before that… there is something we must decide!
You mean Joji Yuki, the leader of our Destron science team?

Exactly…

We must decide how to deal with the man who has committed numerous acts of betrayal against our Destron…

Now, I ask once more. Show me your verdict cards.
Mm…
Here…

Everyone holds the same card, "13"… The Death card. In other words…

Death!!

Great Leader of mighty Destron… Here and now, the top executives have sentenced Joji Yuki to death!

Mm, Joji Yuki… A scientist almost too valuable to kill, but the decision of the top executives is the same as my own!

I order the execution of Joji Yuki!
Then, at once…
I wonder if Takeshi and the others are doing well. Hayato hasn't sent any word either… Honestly, not a thought for how I worry.
No news is good news! The senpai will come back, for sure. After wiping out Destron's overseas branches.

Mm, you're right…

Destron… They really are a terrifying bunch.

Destron's hallmark is…

they never show themselves to anyone, they draw up thorough plans, and then they suddenly strike! Even now, somewhere, in secret…
That's exactly why you're here, to sniff out their moves! I'm counting on you.
Yes…
Howdy!
Oh? You're… the one who delivered that cactus by mistake, aren't you?
Cactus? What are you talking about?
Honestly, playing dumb… So what is it today?
Yes… A bouquet, as a gift.
A bouquet, as a gift? From who?
Oyassan, you sly dog.
Let's see… It's from someone called Destron.
Hey, you! What did the person who ordered this bouquet look like?

H-hold on a minute! I don't know anyth… Oh, right!

I think I've got a copy of the address… Here it is!
3-53-2 Sendagaya, Shibuya Ward, Tokyo, Sendagaya New Palace No. 318… This is!?
It's Taki's apartment! What on earth is going on?
We should be safe now that we've run this far…
Operate on my arm…
But, Mr. Yuki!
I know… This arm Marshal Armor did this to… it won't… it'll never be the same again… ugh…
Operate on this arm so it can be fitted with the attachments I've been secretly developing…

But, Mr. Yuki…

those attachments haven't even been tested on humans yet! It's dangerous!

I don't care! They nearly took my life once already! If the operation fails, I've lost nothing…

What are you hesitating for? I'm asking you! I won't die, I'll be fine! Ugh…
Mr. Yuki!
I'll survive… I won't die until I've had my revenge on Marshal Armor! Ugh… Hurry, operate on my arm!!
Mr. Yuki, understood… We'll try!
Mr. Yuki… How's the artificial arm working?
Ah… The operation was a great success! You two really are wonderful assistants.

No, not at all…

More importantly… we can't stay here forever. We need to get somewhere safe where we can settle down, quickly…
Found him! The traitor, Joji Yuki!

Damn… I won't be caught in a place like this!

Until I've defeated Marshal Armor… I absolutely cannot die!! Taaah!
Joji Yuki, once one of Destron's finest scientists… Why was he being hunted by the very organization he had belonged to? The story goes back a few hours…
Joji Yuki! By the verdict of the Supreme Executive Council, you are under arrest!
Under arrest!?
Th-that's absurd! Give us a reason!

…!?

Marshal Armor…?
The reason… is the many acts of betrayal you have committed to date.
Acts of betrayal? I've worked my heart out for Destron!
That's right! This is a trap to frame Mr. Yuki!
Silence!! Anyone who interferes will be deemed equally guilty and executed!
You… have no right to give orders to my assistants!
You can talk big… for now!! Come!
I'll explain it to the Great Leader myself! It must be some mistake… Don't worry!
Take him away!
Sir!!
Mr. Yuki…
I'll be right back… Keep up the research until then!
We shall now… in the name of the mighty Great Leader of Destron, carry out the execution of the traitor Joji Yuki.
Wait! You won't let me say a single word in my defense? Let me talk to the Great Leader! The Great Leader!

It's pointless…

The Great Leader will not speak with you! The decision of the top executives… is the decision of the Great Leader!

Look! At that pool…
A pool of sulfuric acid! I'll kill you slowly, little by little! Untie the rope!
Eeee!!

Kuh… So that's it!?

Branding me a traitor so you can kill me… This is your trap, isn't it, Marshal Armor?

Yuki… you're No. 1 on the science team!

And you've got plenty of assistants on your side… Sooner or later, you'd become one of Destron's top executives.

But… to me, you're in the way! I'll eliminate you before my position is threatened!
Damn you… Marshal Armor!! You…!
Destron has no need of you! First… we melt your right arm!
Uwaaaagh!!
Suffer… writhe! Now the left arm melts too!!
What's going on!?
We've come to rescue you! We're escaping with you!!
Kuh… ugh…

uncertain: U05135/U05140: reading glosses in （） (ドクトル・G（ゲー）, 結城丈二（ゆうき じょうじ）, etc.) dropped.
U05136/U05137: Doktor G's German-accented 仮面ラーイダ rendered 'Kamen Raaider' so Baron Fang's correction works; 痞敵 read as 宿敵 (archenemy, rendered 'accursed').
U05164: 決谷区千駄谷 / 千谷ニューパレス read as 渋谷区千駄ヶ谷 / 千駄ヶ谷ニューパレス (Shibuya Ward, Sendagaya).
U05209: 左腕も溶ける kept as written ('left arm too') although only the right arm is lost in the show.
